title: Mount an operator-supplied CA trust so external PostgreSQL can use sslMode=verify-ca/verify-full
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
Mount an operator-supplied CA trust (Secret) for external PostgreSQL so `sslMode=verify-ca|verify-full` work for JDBC (Flyway, Keycloak) and R2DBC, then restore `verify-full` in `examples/external-external.yaml`.

## Status in the ledger
still deferred after review cycle 1 (2026-11-11). The chart now REFUSES `verify-ca`/`verify-full` at render (they rendered and then crash-looped), so the gap is fail-closed; `require` encrypts without authenticating the server. Owner decision: ship the CA trust mount (values for a CA Secret, `sslrootcert`/`sslRootCert` on the JDBC and R2DBC URLs, Keycloak `KC_DB_URL`), with a TLS PostgreSQL fixture to qualify it.

## Evidence
The chart accepts verify-ca/verify-full since OM-01.02 but mounts no root certificate; pgjdbc's default LibPQFactory needs `~/.postgresql/root.crt` or `sslrootcert`, which the read-only backend (no home directory) does not have. Pre-existing; round-1 review finding B13 of PR #109's follow-up.

## Source spec
`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-gh-109-resolve-review-findings.md`

Proposed parent: E18 (#18), because: installation hardening for the pilot release.

body:

## What

title: Process tenants with bounded parallelism instead of one at a time per wake-up
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
Tenants are processed one at a time per wake-up (concatMap over tenants and items), so one slow handler delays every other tenant's work, audit publication included; bounded tenant parallelism with a configurable concurrency is needed before multi-tenant load.

## Evidence
PR #111 review comment 4511332988 (WorkProcessor.runOnce). Serial dispatch is the documented v1 model (contract "Lifecycle"); parallel tenants also multiply the unpooled connections the REQUIRES_NEW audit outcome path relies on (contract, durability step 5), so the change needs the pooling decision first.

title: Record abstract/default and type-parameter bounds in the frozen contract-shape test
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
The frozen v1 shape test does not record whether an interface method is abstract or default, nor type-parameter bounds, so adding an abstract method to `WorkHandler` or `DispatchAuthorization` (which breaks every implementer) passes as an appended line and turning a default method abstract changes no line at all.

## Evidence
Owner-deferred 2026-11-12. Source: walkthrough of PR #111 at 285d862 and the spec's "Independent review of d3b985d (R4)" (B3; `DurableWorkContractTest.java:279`, `contract-shape-v1.txt`). `shapeOf` writes `method <type> <signature>` from `getDeclaredMethods()` without `Method.isDefault()` or `getTypeParameters()` bounds. Both published interfaces have only abstract methods today, so nothing is misrecorded yet; the fix changes the format of every frozen method line, which is why it was not folded into R9.

title: Bound owlmast.jobs.lease-duration below PostgreSQL's timeout integer limit
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
`owlmast.jobs.lease-duration` has no upper bound: above about 24.8 days the millisecond value passed to PostgreSQL's `statement_timeout` and `transaction_timeout` exceeds its integer limit, the setting is rejected and every processor step and handler transaction fails.

## Evidence
Owner-deferred 2026-11-12. Source: walkthrough of PR #111 at 285d862 and the spec's "Independent review of d3b985d (R4)" (B6; `RetryPolicy`, `JobsProperties`, `R2dbcWorkRepository.limitStatementTime` and `limitTransactionTime`). PostgreSQL accepts at most 2147483647 ms for both settings. R9 replaced the handler's per-statement limit by a transaction limit counted from the claim but added no bound on the lease, so the gap is unchanged; a lease of weeks is far outside any sensible configuration (default PT30S), and the fix is a documented maximum validated at binding time.

## Source spec
`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-om-01-03-recover-background-work-and-record-mutation-evidence.md`

Proposed parent: E06 (#6), because: configuration validation of the jobs module.

title: Fail audit publication when the event id already exists for another tenant
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
When an `audit.event` row with the same event id already exists for another tenant, the guarded publication upsert changes no row, yet the intent is marked published, so that tenant's committed mutation has no history record (AC4) and nothing reports it.

## Evidence
Owner-deferred 2026-11-12. Source: walkthrough of PR #111 at 285d862 and the spec's "Independent review of d3b985d (R4)" (B7; `R2dbcAuditStore.java:54` `where ... audit.event.tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id`, and the `published_at` update that follows). `event_id` is the primary key across tenants and event ids are server-generated random UUIDs, so a collision needs a hand-inserted row; a fix would tell a repeat (0 rows, own tenant's `SUCCEEDED` row present) from a foreign-tenant conflict and fail the latter as non-retryable.

title: Use one waiting-time definition for tenant discovery and the claim order
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
Tenant discovery ranks a tenant's expired leases by `lease_expires_at`, while the claim inside a tenant orders every due item by `next_attempt_at`, so the item that made a tenant first in the wake-up is not necessarily the one claimed first.

## Evidence
Owner-deferred 2026-11-12. Source: walkthrough of PR #111 at 285d862 and the spec's "Independent review of d3b985d (R4)" (B8; `R2dbcWorkRepository.dueTenants` `order by min(case when status = 'PENDING' then next_attempt_at else lease_expires_at end)` against the claim's `order by next_attempt_at, created_at`). Both orders are fair on their own and no due item becomes unclaimable; the mismatch only changes the order inside one tenant when an expired lease and older pending items coexist. Aligning them means choosing one waiting-time definition for both queries and re-pinning `anExpiredLeaseCountsAsWaitingSinceItsLeaseRanOut`.

## Source spec
`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-om-01-03-recover-background-work-and-record-mutation-evidence.md`

Proposed parent: E06 (#6), because: fairness under real load.

title: Bring failures raised outside controllers and the authentication challenge under the RFC 9457 envelope
body:
Deferred from epic E01 (#1). Source: deferred-work ledger, `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md`.

## What
Bring failures raised outside controllers (web filters, codecs) and authentication/authorization exceptions under the RFC 9457 envelope with their own status.

## Status in the ledger
partly resolved 2026-11-12 (PR #119 round 4, walkthrough risk 6; E01-R-05). UnhandledFailureAdvice now keeps the status of an `ErrorResponse`, a `@ResponseStatus` class and Spring Security's `AccessDeniedException`/`AuthenticationException` (by class name: 403/401), and gives the shared kernel's own failures theirs (`OperationDeniedException` 403, bounded-blocking capacity 503 and deadline 504, scope failures 500). Still deferred: failures raised outside controllers (web filters, codecs), and the authentication challenge (`WWW-Authenticate`), which E02 owns. E02 must also remove the two security class names from the guard (or replace them with its own advice): a controller advice answers before Spring Security's exception translation filter sees the failure.

## Evidence
PR #112 thread 4551653387. UnhandledFailureAdvice covers controller exceptions (500); a filter-level failure still gets Spring Boot's default application/json body, and a future AccessDeniedException would answer 500 unless mapped. No filter or security dependency exists before E02.

title: Bound database connections: pooling decision and connection limits for the backend and Keycloak
body:
From the E01 retrospective (`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-retro-2026-11-12.md`).

## What
The backend uses unpooled R2DBC connections and the chart sets no `max_connections` or role `CONNECTION LIMIT`; the bundled Keycloak shares the server with its default pool of 100. Each failed audited mutation takes a second connection for the separate outcome write, so connection exhaustion could drop audit outcomes or Keycloak readiness. Plausible, untested.

## Evidence
Retrospective B4. `DurableWorkContractTest` (`io.r2dbc:r2dbc-pool` is refused on purpose), `AuditConfiguration.java`, `docs/durable-work-and-audit-contract.md` (durability step 5), chart `postgresql-deployment.yaml`.

## Done when
Decide pooling (with separate headroom for the outcome path) and set server and per-role connection limits in the chart; add a test that drives concurrent failures to the limit.

Proposed parent: E18 (#18).

title: Keep a blocking call that fails after its deadline from being logged with its stack trace
body:
Found while working through the E01 retrospective remediation.

## What
When `BoundedBlocking` gives up on a call at its deadline, the worker thread is interrupted. If the blocking code then throws, the error has no subscriber and Reactor logs it through `onErrorDropped` at ERROR with the full stack trace and message, which bypasses the `SafeFailure` rule (class names only). No production caller of `BoundedBlocking` exists yet.

## Evidence
Found while writing `UnhandledFailureIT` for E01-R-05 (the first version of the deadline endpoint used a bare `Thread.sleep`). `platform/blocking/BoundedBlocking.java`.

## Done when
A late failure of a timed-out blocking call is dropped or logged through `SafeFailure`; a test plants a secret in the late exception and asserts it is not logged.

Proposed parent: E02 (#2).

title: Make `helm upgrade` from chart 0.1.0 work: the backend Deployment cannot change from rolling to Recreate in place
body:
